description: Read one published cocktail recipe by name or slug, the same fields as the public page at /cocktails/<slug>. drinkedin_list_data_products names the paid cocktail feed and does not deliver rows; GET /api/data/v1/cocktails still needs x402 or a licence when it would return rows. The match is exact on the published name or slug after folding case, accents, and punctuation. It is not a prefix, an ingredient search, or a list. Success returns found and recipe (as structuredContent and as JSON text). recipe carries only the public-page fields, the canonical url, and the page provenance. An unknown name, an unpublished cocktail, or a cocktail with no public slug returns found false, recipe null, and browse_url /cocktails/. No credentials and no payment. Read-only and repeatable.

name.description: Cocktail name or slug. Exact match after folding case, accents, and punctuation. Not a prefix and not an ingredient.

name: drinkedin_get_cocktail_recipe

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.

browse_url.description: Present when no single public recipe matched
